Life is full of small surprises. Last Thursday, Nina and Jack went to the science lab. It takes twenty minutes to get to the science lab by bike. The chemistry experiment made a loud pop.
Nina and Jack had great fun there. Nina is going to travel to Sydney in July. Nina borrowed a book about English from the zoo. For example, the library stays open during finals.
Nina thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. Both of them like rice and coffee. The science lab is one of the best places in the city. The school is a short distance away.
Nina learned a lot about English. They took many photos at the playground. Nina bought a sweater at the shop yesterday.
